title: Database agent prompt front matter
description: The YAML front matter of every prompt file in fabric/agent/prompts (ADR 0013). tests/unit/Agent.PromptPack.Tests.ps1 parses the front matter and validates it against this schema, then checks the rules a schema can't express: the id matches the file name, the scenario folder exists, the prompt text is read-only and uses known placeholders, and nothing hard-codes an answer.

id.description: Equal to the file name without .md: <name>.<in-hub|skills>.

scenario.description: A folder under scenarios/ (resource-governance and log-rate-pressure since Phase 11, and the eight wait-family scenarios since Phase 25b; the cpu-pressure and inefficient-query scenarios also produce resource-governance pressure on T3), any (cross-incident wrap-up), or setup (session setup).

incident.description: True for prompts used during an incident. Incident prompts must work on T1, T2, and T3, because the Database Agent's target coverage isn't documented.

defaultTarget.description: The target the scenario runs on by default (architecture, ADR 0010).

producedBy.description: For scenario resource-governance only: the scenario folders whose workload produces it.

surface.description: in-hub-agent: the Database Agent and Copilot in Database Hub (presenter-driven UI). skills: GitHub Copilot CLI or VS Code with the documented plugins, the telemetry agent instructions, and the Learn MCP server.

dataSources.description: hub-estate and hub-performance: what Database Hub shows. databasehub-skill: the microsoft-sql-fdh plugin. telemetry-endpoint: the documented telemetry REST endpoint through the Learn agent instructions block. sql-diagnostics-skills: the microsoft-sql plugin over a SQL connection. scenario-record: demo.scenario_runs, read only. learn-mcp: the Microsoft Learn MCP server.

capability.description: What the surface is expected to be able to do with this prompt. Never the answer itself.

responseShape.description: The structure the prompt asks for, not its content.

fallback.description: The fallback demo when this surface or prompt doesn't work.

actionPolicy.description: read-only: investigation only. propose-only: the agent may propose an action but never applies it.

adrPrompts.description: The ADR 0013 prompt kinds this file covers. The index test checks that both surfaces cover all twelve.

sources.description: Microsoft Learn, GitHub, or VS Code documentation pages the prompt relies on.

reviewed.description: UTC date the prompt and its sources were last checked.
